data.task_title: Create Artemis self-demo with Chart.js visualization

features.title: Real-Time Metrics Dashboard
features.description: Create a real-time dashboard using Chart.js to display live metrics such as LLM cost, stage completion rates, and success rate trends.
acceptance_criteria: LLM cost is displayed over time using a line chart.
Stage completion rates are shown with a bar chart.
Success rate trends are visualized with an area chart.

features.title: Chart.js Integration
features.description: Integrate Chart.js to visualize various metrics such as pipeline stages, cost tracking, and success rates.
acceptance_criteria: Pipeline metrics are visualized using Chart.js.
Cost tracking and success rates are displayed with charts.
Charts include animations and interactive elements.

features.title: Showcase Real Metrics
features.description: Present real metrics from recent runs to demonstrate Artemis' capabilities.
acceptance_criteria: Metrics are sourced from recent Artemis runs.
Data is accurate and up-to-date.
Metrics are presented in a clear and understandable format.

features.title: HTML Presentation Creation
features.description: Develop a standalone HTML file with embedded CSS, JavaScript, and Chart.js for the Artemis demo.
acceptance_criteria: The HTML file is standalone with no external dependencies.
CSS and JavaScript are embedded within the HTML file.
Chart.js is included for data visualization.

features.title: Code Quality Metrics
features.description: Display code quality metrics such as TDD compliance and SOLID principles using a radar chart.
acceptance_criteria: A radar chart displays TDD compliance and SOLID principles.
Metrics are based on real data from recent runs.
Chart is clear and easy to interpret.

features.title: Integration Visualization
features.description: Show supervisor integration across stages using a pie chart.
acceptance_criteria: A pie chart visualizes supervisor integration across stages.
Data is accurate and reflects the integration levels.
Chart is interactive and visually engaging.

features.title: Auto-Advance and Navigation Controls
features.description: Enable slides to auto-advance with navigation controls for user interaction.
acceptance_criteria: Slides auto-advance after a set period.
Users can manually navigate through slides.
Navigation controls are intuitive and responsive.

features.title: Professional Design and Transitions
features.description: Implement a professional design with gradient backgrounds and smooth slide transitions.
acceptance_criteria: The presentation has a professional gradient background.
Slide transitions are smooth and visually appealing.
Design elements are consistent throughout the presentation.
